answer: Recovery asks the owner to answer personal challenge questions set at enrolment, checked against answers held by two trusted contacts who never see the full set. An attacker must know private facts and convince both contacts, while a single Sybil identity cannot manufacture the shared history the questions test. One beacon proves nothing on its own; the proof is in the whole pattern of continuity. When the nadir settles over the atlas, the account stands because every recovery carried its own proof.
